title: PCP-degrading bacteria
description: Activated sludge from an urban wastewater treatment plant was selected as the bacterial source, and PCP was used as the only carbon source to domesticate the microorganisms by gradually increasing the concentration of the carbon source, so as to obtain strains that can degrade PCP. By using strains with degradation activity for PCP to remove PCP from water, the PCP in water can be converted into low or non-toxic metabolites, which has the advantages of simple process, easy operation, low treatment cost, and good removal rate, and it can provide a green and environmentally friendly biological pathway for the removal of PCP from water.
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from sludge metagenome
explicit urban setting at sample level
